input.quote: (b) HDI acknowledges that the Company is currently a party to a web-hosting agreement with Globix Corporation (the \"Globix Agreement\")
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless provision anywhere: Section 9 (Warranties) ends with the Globix acknowledgement and is followed immediately by Section 10 (General Provisions), and there is no limitation-of-liability article either. Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and IP-infringement language return nothing; the only third-party IP reference (Section 7.2) is a mutual advertising covenant, not an indemnity. HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site and holds a licence to our Marks, so the absence of any HDI IP-infringement indemnity is walk-away territory under this rule. We have therefore inserted a preferred-level HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, HDI-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with the standard notice, control and cooperation procedure, plus a narrow Company indemnity confined to Company-provided Content and our own breach of law. We did not add the fallback three-times-annual-fees super-cap, which would only serve to cap HDI's exposure in an agreement that currently has no liability cap.

proposal.summary: Insert HDI indemnity (IP, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with claim procedure and a narrow Company indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, HDI-caused data breach and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, together with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure and a Company indemnity limited to Company-provided Content and our breach of law. If HDI prefers, we can fall back to an IP-only indemnity with the customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a super-cap of three times annual fees.

ops.text: Indemnification. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Site or any services or deliverables provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (2) HDI's breach of applicable law; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of the Company's data or Content caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall defend and indemnify HDI against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of Content provided by the Company or the Company's breach of applicable law. The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any such claim, the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.
